title: LoomAIProposalImportExportAndPromotionSafety
clause: Restore reviewed AI proposals and safe import/export without bypassing Loom or domain authority.

current_source_discovery: Inspect stable-main loom_ai suggestion/promotion, document import/export and review UI/tests.
Trace every proposal state transition to canonical mutation and EventLedger boundaries.
stop_conditions: AI output can mutate canonical state without explicit accepted promotion.
Import/export identity, scope or provenance is ambiguous.

scope.summary: Keep AI useful for linking, labeling and structuring Loom content while proposals remain reviewable and canonical Surreal mutations remain explicit, attributable and reversible.
forbidden_paths: AI direct write to canonical Loom/domain records
Implicit acceptance from viewing or navigation
acceptance_criteria: AI suggestions for links, tags, summaries, organization and projections persist as typed pending proposals with model/run provenance, scope and deterministic idempotency keys.
Accept/reject/edit/batch promotion is explicit; accepted promotion atomically writes canonical Surreal state plus EventLedger receipt and remains replay/retry safe.
Imports validate schema/version, remap project-qualified identity, quarantine unresolved sources and cannot import permissions or overwrite canonical records silently.
Exports include only authorized canonical resources and typed relation/provenance manifests; derived content never widens source scope.
Native review UI clearly distinguishes proposed, edited, accepted, rejected, stale, conflict and failed-promotion states with Argus proof.
proof_targets: Run real-Surreal proposal lifecycle and atomic promotion failure/retry tests.
Run adversarial import/export identity, scope, duplicate and malformed-bundle tests.

same_project_private_resource_cases: Proposals and exports exclude private resources not granted to the acting Principal.
cross_account_negative_cases: Forged proposal, bundle or project identifiers fail closed.
derived_resource_non_widening_cases: Suggestions, summaries, diffs and exports inherit the intersection of their sources.
revocation_and_context_switch_cases: Stale proposals cannot promote after source scope or actor context changes without revalidation.
remote_saas_mcp_sync_cases: External model/service identity never grants local access; imported content is quarantined.
metadata_side_channel_cases: Proposal counts, titles, diffs, model context and export manifests do not reveal denied resources.

hbr_int_009_tier_obligations.evidence: proposal, decision, promotion, import/export, denial and recovery events
proposal queue, stale state, promotion and quarantine health
model/review UI crash correlation and replay handles

risk_if_missed: AI or import paths can silently bypass canonical review, privacy and provenance, recreating hidden authority outside SurrealDB.

risks: Batch accept promotes stale unauthorized proposals.

research_provenance.selected_approach: Typed reviewable proposals with explicit atomic promotion and scope-preserving import/export.
